messages:
maya: FYI — saw a policy merge from yesterday that appears to have introduced an 'override' rule giving cross-org read access to a project-scoped role. hit two orgs in prod :grimacing:

deploy-bot: deploy finished: service/policy-store @ 2026-03-19T21:02:11Z (commit 8f3b2d) by jen

chris: link to the PR?

maya: PR #5421 — jen merged it. here's the snippet I pulled from the deployed policy-store config:
```yaml
policies:
  - id: workspace_isolation
    match: "org:* / workspace:*"
    effect: deny
  - id: override_temp
    match: "project:123 / role:viewer"
    effect: allow
```

oliver: That second rule is dangerously broad — sounds like the merger appended an allow after the deny instead of creating a scoped override. Did we change policy merge order with the new fast-merge patch?

samir: I pulled admission logs — there is a race where policy-merger writes can end up ordered by commit time instead of priority. log snippet:
```log
2026-03-19T21:03:02Z policy-merger apply start commit=8f3b2d
2026-03-19T21:03:03Z policy-merger write override_temp priority=100
2026-03-19T21:03:03Z policy-merger finalize workspace_isolation priority=50
2026-03-19T21:03:03Z admission allowed request=ListProjects org=acme-corp subject=svcacc:billing-reader
```

jen: I merged this to unblock a billing migration test, didn't realize the rule would be global. starting rollback now.

maya: Good. We need a canary rollback and then full rollback. Also we should rotate/deny any KMS decrypt grants given to the affected service accounts while we audit for data access. Export audit logs for the last 24h for the affected orgs.

chris: On it — kicking off canary rollback to region us-west-2 and exporting audit logs.

deploy-bot: rollback job started: job/rollback-1788888888 by jen (canary us-west-2)

oliver: Also adding a unit/integration CI test to assert policy precedence (deny > allow) and a merge-gate that warns on global-match allow rules. filing ticket #7890.

samir: I posted a short triage checklist in GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/policy-store/issues/traige-1788 (contains commands to identify affected orgs and KMS grants)

jen: canary rollback succeeded. rolling full now. will open incident postmortem after full roll. apologies team.

maya: please ensure the incident includes: timeline, affected orgs, list of svcacc keys touched, KMS grant rotations, and CI merge-gate follow-up. tagging security oncall.

chris: :thumbsup: will attach audit exports and a short query to detect any read operations during the window.

maya: thanks everyone. once rollback completed we'll schedule a quick postmortem and follow-up RFC on policy merge ordering and tests.
